# @generated by stategate from sensor.yaml. Do not edit: change the model and run `stategate gen`.
#
# On a PC: cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build
# In ESP-IDF: put this folder under components/; the machine and its nodes
# build as one component (the fake HAL, tests and simulator stay out).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

file(GLOB SG_SOURCES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/gen/*.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/actions/*.c
     ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/services/*.c)
list(FILTER SG_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/gen/fake\\.c$")

if(ESP_PLATFORM)
  idf_component_register(SRCS ${SG_SOURCES} INCLUDE_DIRS src)
  target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -Wswitch-enum -Werror=switch-enum)
  return()
endif()

project(sensor C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Every (state, event) pair is a case with no default: a missing one is a
# compile error, not a silent fall-through.
set(SG_WARNINGS -Wall -Wextra -Wswitch-enum -Werror)

add_library(sensor STATIC ${SG_SOURCES} src/gen/fake.c)
target_include_directories(sensor PUBLIC src)
target_compile_options(sensor PRIVATE ${SG_WARNINGS})

# Unity, the test framework ESP-IDF ships. To build offline, point the
# STATEGATE_UNITY_DIR environment variable at a local copy of Unity v2.6.0.
include(FetchContent)
if(DEFINED ENV{STATEGATE_UNITY_DIR})
  set(FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_UNITY $ENV{STATEGATE_UNITY_DIR})
endif()
FetchContent_Declare(unity
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/ThrowTheSwitch/Unity.git
  GIT_TAG v2.6.0
  GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(unity)

enable_testing()
file(GLOB SG_TESTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/tests/*.c)
foreach(test_src ${SG_TESTS})
  get_filename_component(name ${test_src} NAME_WE)
  add_executable(test_${name} ${test_src})
  target_link_libraries(test_${name} PRIVATE sensor unity)
  target_compile_options(test_${name} PRIVATE ${SG_WARNINGS})
  add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND test_${name})
endforeach()

add_executable(sim examples/sim.c)
target_link_libraries(sim PRIVATE sensor)
target_compile_options(sim PRIVATE ${SG_WARNINGS})
